scope: Read-only coverage UI metric/association/freshness/HTTP semantics and real browser interaction with a freshly started server. Regression excludes computed/inferred call targets from the direct-entry graph. No engine behavior, original comparison or live replacement is validated.

checks: binary percentage matches global function links
partial work view has correct total and scope
feature detail shows exact scope, research, addresses and gaps
interior hexadecimal address finds owning function
function details include direct call edges and limits
refresh rebuilds current snapshot without losing filters
mobile viewport has no horizontal page overflow

limitations: Percentages are bounded to explicit inventory associations and registered checklist stages.
Equal behavior weighting is not an effort/importance or whole-game completion estimate.
UI checks do not refresh any engine comparisons or integration evidence.
The browser source snapshot can include separate concurrent register/accounting changes; its SHA-256 is retained as historical provenance.
